pages.title: Spin Foam Lattice
pages.text: A lattice of spin networks evolving in time, the loop quantum gravity picture of spacetime as discrete quanta of area and volume. It looks like a soap foam frozen in place, but each bubble is a quantum of space itself. Pressing it does not compress it; space does not come in smaller units.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed Graviton Crystals through the Graviton Condenser together with a qubit to track the states and a condensate to hold them coherent. Spacetime started showing up in discrete chunks, which loop gravity had promised.
